cardBody: Found a bug or have an idea? Send feedback — you choose whether to open a prefilled GitHub issue or download a report; nothing is sent on its own.
title: Send feedback
intro: Tell us what's wrong or what you'd like. Nothing is posted automatically — opening a GitHub issue fills it in for you to review and submit, and Download just saves a file.
messagePlaceholder: What happened, what you expected, and any steps to reproduce…
messageHint: Required. GitHub issues are public — don't paste passwords, tokens or private logs.
includeDiagnostics: Include diagnostic info (edition, version, your browser, viewport and the current page) — shown in full below
showPreview: Preview exactly what will be shared
privacyNote: The diagnostics we add contain no secrets, tokens or IP addresses. Opening a GitHub issue sends the prefilled text to github.com when the tab opens — you review and submit it there, and the issue is public.
truncateWarn: Your message is long — the GitHub link will be shortened. Use Download for the full report.
openIssueHint: Opens a prefilled issue in a new tab
